EnableViewmodelArms.title: Enable Viewmodel Arms
EnableViewmodelArms.tooltip: Adds an arm model to every item/tool you can hold.

EnableHeadBob.title: Enable Head Bobbing
EnableHeadBob.tooltip: Makes the camera bob while you're moving.

HeadBobStrength.title: Head Bob Strength
HeadBobStrength.tooltip: The strength of the Head Bob effect.

EnableViewmodelBob.title: Enable Viewmodel Bobbing
EnableViewmodelBob.tooltip: Makes your held item/tool bob while you're moving.

ViewmodelBobStrength.title: Viewmodel Bob Strength
ViewmodelBobStrength.tooltip: The strength of the Viewmodel Bob effect.

EnableViewmodelOffset.title: Enable Viewmodel Offset
EnableViewmodelOffset.tooltip: Makes your held item/tool move up/down based on how far up/down you are looking.

ViewmodelOffsetStrength.title: Viewmodel Offset Strength
ViewmodelOffsetStrength.tooltip: The strength of the Viewmodel Offset effect.

EnableViewmodelSway.title: Enable Viewmodel Sway
EnableViewmodelSway.tooltip: Makes your held item/tool lag behind the camera as you look around.

ViewmodelSwayStrength.title: Viewmodel Sway Strength
ViewmodelSwayStrength.tooltip: The strength of the Viewmodel Sway effect.

EnableLandingAnim.title: Enable Landing Animation
EnableLandingAnim.tooltip: Makes the camera move downward a bit when you land with some speed.

MaxLandingAnimDistance.title: Max Landing Animation Distance
MaxLandingAnimDistance.tooltip: How far the camera will move downward before bottoming out.

MaxLandingAnimRecoverySpeed.title: Max Landing Animation Recovery Speed
MaxLandingAnimRecoverySpeed.tooltip: The maximum speed with which the camera can move back upwards.

LandingAnimRecoverySmoothness.title: Landing Animation Recovery Smoothness
LandingAnimRecoverySmoothness.tooltip: How smoothly the camera will move back upwards.

EnableBreathingAnim.title: Enable Breathing Animation
EnableBreathingAnim.tooltip: Makes the held item/tool move very subtly while you're standing still.

BreathingAnimStrength.title: Breathing Animation Strength
BreathingAnimStrength.tooltip: The strength of the breathing effect.

EnableScoutAnim.title: Enable Scout Launcher Fire Animation
EnableScoutAnim.tooltip: Makes the camera and scout launcher recoil when you launch a scout.

EnableSprintingAnim.title: Enable Sprinting Animation
EnableSprintingAnim.tooltip: (REQUIRES HIKER'S MOD) Makes the held item/tool move downward while you're sprinting.

FixViewmodelClipping.title: Fix Viewmodel Clipping
FixViewmodelClipping.tooltip: Changes the camera's near clip plane to prevent held items and viewmodel arms from clipping into the camera. May cause other less noticeable visual bugs.

HideStowedItems.title: Hide Stowed Items
HideStowedItems.tooltip: Makes held items move fully offscreen when they are stowed (i.e. while piloting the ship, roasting marshmallows, or holding another tool).
